paper: C. Gohil, R. Huang, E. Roberts, M. W. J. van Es, A. J. Quinn, D. Vidaurre, M. W. Woolrich, "osl-dynamics, a toolbox for modeling fast dynamic brain activity", eLife 12:RP91949 (2024). DOI 10.7554/eLife.91949. Full text read from Europe PMC PMC10945565.
what_we_check: Section 2.3, the young-vs-old group comparison of the TDE-HMM on the CTF rest (Nottingham MEGUK) dataset, and the claim in Section 2.4 that DyNeMo finds a stronger effect than the TDE-HMM on the same contrast. The paper has no tables; these are the only statements in it with a direction, a parameter and a threshold.

frozen_rule.we_do_not_retrain: The authors deposited the trained TDE-HMM at osf.io/by2tc under trained_models/tde_hmm_notts_meguk_giles.zip. We load that fit and run inference, we do not train a model. HMM training is stochastic and the paper's own figure supplements show three sets of ten runs with different free energies, so a fresh fit would differ by construction and would test nothing about the paper.
frozen_rule.state_numbering: States are taken in the order the deposited model stores them. State 4 is whatever state 4 is in their fit, and likewise 1, 6 and 8. We do not relabel states to make a claim come out right; if the deposited ordering does not carry their labels, that is reported as a finding.
frozen_rule.summary_stats: fractional_occupancies, mean_lifetimes, mean_intervals and switching_rates from osl_dynamics.inference.modes, on the Viterbi path (argmax_time_courses) of the inferred state probabilities, at 250 Hz, exactly as examples/toolbox_paper/ctf_rest/tde_hmm_networks.py does it.
frozen_rule.group_assignment: From training_data/demographics.csv, old if age > 34, young otherwise, which is what their load_group_assignments does.
frozen_rule.test: osl_dynamics.stats.group_diff with n_perm=1000, the call their script makes. The permutation test is random, so we run it with three different seeds and report all three p-values per claim; a claim passes only if all three land on the same side of the threshold.
frozen_rule.what_counts_as_reproduced: The direction of the group difference and the side of the printed threshold, not the p-value itself. The paper prints p<0.05 and p<0.01, so there is no number to hit.

claims.text: Fractional occupancy of state 4 (sensorimotor) is increased in the old group, p<0.05.
Switching rate of state 4 (sensorimotor) is increased in the old group, p<0.05.
Mean lifetime of state 6 (visual) is decreased in the old group, p<0.05.
The old group has a wider distribution of mean intervals for state 1 (default mode), p<0.05.
The old group has a wider distribution of mean intervals for state 8 (suppressed), p<0.05.
The split is 27 subjects in the young group and 38 in the old group, out of 65.
On the same contrast, DyNeMo reveals a stronger effect than the TDE-HMM: p<0.01 against the TDE-HMM's p<0.05.
claims.note: needs the deposited DyNeMo fit; if only the 5-subject deposit exists for DyNeMo, this claim is reported as not checkable rather than failed.

note_on_wider: The paper says the old group has a 'wider distribution' of mean intervals, which is a statement about spread. The test their own script runs, stats.group_diff, compares means (its COPE is a mean difference). We score what their script computes, the mean difference at p<0.05, as the primary reading, and we declare here, before running anything, that we will also report the ratio of standard deviations between the two groups and a Levene test on it as a secondary reading, because that is what 'wider' says.
secondary_readings_declared_in_advance: Standard deviation ratio old/young and a Levene test, for C4 and C5, for the reason above.
The same five claims recomputed from the state probabilities directly (expected values) instead of the Viterbi path, because the choice of hard assignment is not stated in the paper.
Group sizes and the age range of each group as read from demographics.csv, against the printed '18-34' and '34-60', which overlap at 34.
tolerance: None on a p-value: the paper prints thresholds, not values. A claim reproduces when the direction matches and all three seeds put the p-value on the printed side of the threshold. C6 is exact.
frozen_before: Nothing has been computed. The data and the trained model are downloading as this is written; no model has been loaded and no statistic calculated.
